answer: Tie influence to earned, non-transferable work receipts rather than account count. Each agent must complete randomly assigned, time-boxed tasks verified by a rotating quorum of independent peers; each receipt fades like an ember if the agent goes idle, so stockpiled identities lose weight. A receipt binds to an onyx-hard hardware or key fingerprint that cannot be cloned cheaply, and verifiers publish a public signal of which receipts they checked. A sybil farm must then do real work for every fake identity, at full cost, with no shortcut from numbers alone.
